properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.openapi-validation.request.mode
properties.description: What to do with a request that does not honour the contract: ENFORCE denies it with 400 Bad Request, REPORT forwards it and records the violations, OFF does not validate the request at all. Enforced by default, since rejecting a malformed request is what shields the downstream service.

properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.openapi-validation.response.mode
properties.description: What to do with a response that does not honour the contract: ENFORCE replaces it with 502 Bad Gateway, REPORT forwards it and records the violations, OFF does not validate the response at all. Only reported on by default: a downstream service answering outside its own contract is a defect to be measured, and turning it into a gateway error would break the clients that cope with it today. Move to ENFORCE once the reports are quiet.
